title: Activate drought anticipatory action coordination
rationale: Severe rainfall deficit and high exposure require immediate coordination before impacts worsen.
actions: Activate a district drought coordination meeting with agriculture, water, livestock, health and disaster risk management offices.
Verify water-point status, pasture condition and livestock movement using local officers and community reports.
Prioritize high-exposure kebeles, wards or settlements for early action support.
Prepare early warning messages explaining expected impacts and recommended household-level preparedness actions.
Review contingency resources for water trucking, livestock feed support, veterinary outreach and targeted cash or voucher support.
source_note: Prototype local knowledge item for drought trigger-level early action planning.

title: Provide drought advisory to farmers and pastoralists
rationale: Farmers and pastoralists need practical guidance on water, pasture, crops and livestock management.
actions: Advise communities to conserve water and protect remaining water sources.
Promote early livestock feed planning, fodder conservation and strategic herd movement where appropriate.
Monitor crop wilting, pasture degradation and livestock body condition during field visits.
Share drought-tolerant crop, forage and animal health messages through extension channels.
Report worsening field conditions to district coordination structures.
source_note: Prototype local knowledge item for agriculture and livestock extension response.

title: Prepare anticipatory drought support package
rationale: Trigger-level drought risk requires rapid planning for targeted support before losses escalate.
actions: Review beneficiary targeting using exposure, vulnerability and community ground-truth reports.
Coordinate with local government to avoid duplication of early action support.
Pre-position or plan support for water access, livestock feed, animal health and household preparedness.
Use community reports to verify where field stress is already emerging.
Prepare monitoring indicators to track whether early actions are reducing impacts.
source_title: Forecast2Action NGO drought early action guide
source_note: Prototype local knowledge item for NGO anticipatory action planning.

title: Increase drought preparedness and monitoring
rationale: Warning-level drought risk requires intensified monitoring and early preparedness before conditions become critical.
actions: Increase monitoring of rainfall performance, water points, pasture condition and crop stress.
Brief local officers and community focal persons about the current warning level.
Prepare drought advisory messages for farmers, pastoralists and vulnerable households.
Collect community observations to confirm whether impacts are already emerging.
Review preparedness options for water, feed, veterinary and social protection support.
source_note: Prototype local knowledge item for drought warning-level preparedness.

title: Prepare for heavy rainfall and localized flooding
rationale: Above-normal rainfall signal may increase flood, road access and displacement risks.
actions: Identify flood-prone settlements, roads, river crossings and drainage hotspots.
Coordinate with local authorities to prepare flood warning and safety messages.
Advise communities to avoid crossing flooded roads, rivers and seasonal streams.
Check readiness of evacuation routes, temporary shelters and emergency communication channels.
Monitor river levels, drainage congestion and community reports of flooded roads.
source_note: Prototype local knowledge item for heavy rainfall and flood preparedness.

title: Advise farmers on heavy rainfall risk
rationale: Heavy rainfall may damage crops, increase disease pressure and disrupt field access.
actions: Advise farmers to improve drainage around fields where feasible.
Monitor crop disease, waterlogging and soil erosion risks.
Warn communities to avoid farming activities in unsafe flood-prone locations during heavy rainfall.
Report flooded roads, damaged fields and crop disease outbreaks to district offices.
Share short advisory messages through extension networks and community focal persons.
source_note: Prototype local knowledge item for agricultural extension during heavy rainfall warnings.

title: Activate flood preparedness and public safety actions
rationale: Trigger-level heavy rainfall risk requires immediate preparedness and public safety messaging.
actions: Activate local flood preparedness coordination.
Issue clear public safety messages for flood-prone areas.
Prioritize monitoring of river crossings, low-lying settlements and roads.
Prepare evacuation support for highly exposed communities where needed.
Use community reports to identify flooded roads, river overflow and blocked drainage.
source_title: Forecast2Action flood trigger early action guide
source_note: Prototype local knowledge item for trigger-level heavy rainfall and flood preparedness.

title: Prepare heat stress advisory
rationale: Heat stress may affect outdoor workers, children, elderly people, livestock and water demand.
actions: Advise communities to reduce strenuous outdoor work during peak heat hours.
Promote drinking water access and shade for people and livestock.
Prioritize heat safety messages for vulnerable people, schools, health posts and pastoral communities.
Monitor livestock heat stress, water demand and unusual illness reports.
Coordinate with health and livestock officers to prepare practical heat stress advisories.
source_note: Prototype local knowledge item for heat stress preparedness.

title: Maintain close monitoring
rationale: Watch-level risk does not yet justify activation but requires close monitoring and readiness.
actions: Continue monitoring rainfall, forecast updates and local observations.
Prepare advisory messages in case the risk level increases.
Ask local officers and community focal persons to report early signs of impact.
Review preparedness plans for the most exposed communities.
Update the dashboard when new climate or community evidence becomes available.
source_note: Prototype local knowledge item for watch-level monitoring.
